name: Spicy Honey Soy Pork Stir-Fry with Noodles, Broccoli Slaw & Carrots

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, remove from heat, uncover, and add rice noodles. Soak for 10 minutes (or prepare according to package instructions). Drain in a colander and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 jalapeño pepper
2 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 lime
2 medium carrots

instructions.primary_message: Halve jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Slice crosswise into thin half-moons and place in a small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeño.
Juice lime into the bowl. Add water, soy sauce, honey, cornstarch, pepper, and salt, then whisk to combine the stir-fry sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp honey
4 tsp cornstarch
black pepper
salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork dry with paper towels and cut into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 pork chops, boneless
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add pork and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned and cooked through, 4-5 minutes. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet with cooking juices for later use.)
While the pork is cooking, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into ¼-inch thick rounds.
Return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add carrot and broccoli slaw; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to soften, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
toasted sesame oil
1 (340 g) pkg broccoli slaw

instructions.primary_message: Add drained noodles, pork, and stir-fry sauce to the skillet, then toss to combine. Continue to cook, tossing occasionally, until noodles are warmed through and sauce thickens, 1-2 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide stir-fry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
